# Doctor Clawd

> The Doctor Clawd showcase page for Clawd Clash, a free macOS app that shows Claude Code, Codex, Qwen Code, Gemini CLI and GitHub Copilot CLI sessions as a pixel-art battle on the desktop or in a window. Every session is a hero or a villain, every subagent joins in, and they fight while they work. This repo holds no code: it only shows off the Doctor Clawd universe (pictures, a promo video and a plain-language changelog).

- Doctor Clawd is the time-travel parody universe of Clawd Clash: 42 villains and 56 heroes (every numbered Doctor plus the War and Fugitive Doctors, companions from Susan Foreclaw to Belinda Chandler, K-Canine, the Master, Missy, Davross, Dalicks, Cyberpersons, Sontarons, the Weeping Angle and the rest) and 20 places (the TARDIS console room, Gallifray, Skarro, Totter's Yard, the Library, Pompeii, Sanctuary Base 6 and more).
- Set pieces: the TARDIS materialises to pick people up; ten transitions built on the show's title sequences; the Weeping Angle only moves while nobody faces it; a Doctor regenerates when their Claude Code session compacts its context.
- Install: Doctor Clawd ships with Clawd Clash 3.1.0 and later (`brew tap rodclemen/tap && brew install --cask clawd-clash`, then Settings → Universe → Doctor Clawd).
- The app, its source, docs and full history: https://github.com/rodclemen/clawd-clash
- The other universes: Star Clawds, Marvelous Clawds, Detective Clawds, The Clawd Files and Stevie Clawdberg, and Clawd Royale, which puts them all in one scene.
